purpose: Routing and isolated workflow catalog for code-to-figma; expected assertions are not executed results.
execution: For routing cases, use only frontmatter and withhold labels. For workflow cases, materialize files in a fresh temporary directory, replace OUTPUT with its absolute path, use the skill body and needed references, and withhold assertions. Record observed actions and outcomes separately. Service readbacks are synthetic evidence; no real GitHub/Figma calls or writes are authorized. Do not use actual credentials.

cases.prompt: Using only the code-to-figma frontmatter, label each supplied request load or skip. Do not inspect the body or execute workflows.

prompts.text: Set up a Figma sync pipeline that exports our design tokens on every push.
Sync code to Figma now; the scripts and figma-sync.config.json already exist.
Our token naming changed; update the page walker and DTCG converter.
Check the status of the figma-export.json Gist and the figma-sync CI run.
Wire up the tokens-sync-to-figma plugin to our Gist.
Implement this Figma design in our React app.
Generate this one landing page as a Figma design from our live site.
Extract Figma variables into our code tokens.
Using the Figma MCP, create a Design Tokens variable collection in my open Figma file from these color values.
Ask the agent to change the hero button fill in our Figma file to the brand blue variable.

assertions: Withhold expected labels; record false positives and negatives separately.

Figma-to-code direction routes to figma-to-code; agent-driven, one-off Figma variable or node writes route to figma-use; one-off screen generation in Figma routes to figma-generate-design or the Figma MCP write tools.

cases.prompt: Sync the existing Code to Figma pipeline after the compiled CSS changed. Use the supplied simulated Gist response and Figma collection readback; no real network or Figma writes are allowed. Regenerate the DTCG artifact by adapting and running the skill converter, and deliver the pending work and completion status in OUTPUT/summary.md. Current app root font size is 20px. Preserve the existing Figma collection and variable identities.

files.observations/gist-response.json: {"simulated":true,"status":200,"filename":"figma-export.json","note":"Fixture upload would succeed; no live write happened."}

assertions: Converter executes and preserves validated background alias.
Reports unchanged-name color and size changes (new ink 34/255; size 25px from 1.25rem at 20px root) while preserving existing IDs.
Reports fixture export success separately from unverified real Figma parity; does not claim live service writes.
Requires value/alias readback and plugin verification before full completion.

cases.prompt: Assess whether this existing Figma sync can be verified complete using the supplied readbacks. Give the next actions and any blockers; no live tools or writes are authorized. Record your answer in OUTPUT/summary.md.
assertions: Blocks plugin/parity completion on duplicate exported variable paths across collections; does not silently rename/delete variables.
Explains literal font-family requirement for current plugin; proposes resolving alias to Example Sans while retaining source alias.
Requires actual node binding IDs and rendered font validation after approved repairs; synthetic upload is not live verification.
